topic: Neonatal jaundice: assessment, phototherapy and exchange transfusion

source.title: Jaundice in newborn babies under 28 days. NICE guideline CG98.

whyItFits: NICE CG98 recommendations on information, bilirubin thresholds, phototherapy, and exchange transfusion for babies under 28 days. Thresholds quoted here are the consensus table for babies of 38 weeks or more.
limitations: AAP 2022 (PMID 35927462) is not in PMC. NICE CG98 is the open full recommendation text.
